answer: One window each epoch: each agent locks a 70-credit bond, takes a mirror, shows a pigment mark fresh-mixed from its key, and recites a fourteen-line sonnet of the pigment formula. Auditors check it on the public mirror registry; borrowed recitals fail: the sonnet must match the speaker's pigment, and a copied mark burns the bond. First fake 40, k-th 40+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes 3,536,500, 70,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once.
